today.title: Arnie and Barney
today.synopsis: When a severe drought threatens their home, two imaginative ants join forces with a superhero mosquito to retrieve their meadow's stolen water in this fantasy adventure animation.

today.title: Clayface
today.synopsis: DC Studios' first-ever foray into the genre, Clayface is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. Clayface unravels one man's horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one's identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

today.title: Forgotten Island
today.synopsis: Your best friendship is worth fighting for. today.title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House
today.synopsis: The beloved and award-winning BBC comedy Ghosts arrives on the big screen this Halloween. Ghosts stars, writers, and creators Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond are back, along with Lolly Adefope, Charlotte Ritchie and Kiell Smith-Bynoe, in a feature length family adventure.

today.title: Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House - Galactic
today.synopsis: Feature film based on the smash hit BBC sitcom Ghosts. The ghostly residents of Button House are adjusting to life without Alison and Mike, but when protesters disrupt the construction of the planned hotel, the ghosts need to find a way to reach their living friends.

today.title: Heart Of The Beast
today.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart Of The Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

today.title: Other Mommy
today.synopsis: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

today.title: Other Mommy Galactic
today.synopsis: From producer James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror, and Blumhouse Atomic Monster, the studio behind Backrooms and Obsession, comes a terrifying trip from breakout genre director Rob Savage, into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother. Academy Award-winner Jessica Chastain stars in dual roles as Bela's mother and as Other Mommy, a manifestation of the entity.

today.title: Street Fighter Galactic

today.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp

today.title: Verity
today.synopsis: Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford and Lowen Ashleigh, a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity.
